records.title: Tŷ Mawr / Great House Farm (Cydfin Farm), Llandough-juxta-Penarth
records.description: The property: the former manorial house at Llandough near Penarth, demolished in December 1988. First named in the 1824 David Stewart survey of the Bute estates as “Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm”.

records.title: Llandough Farm, Llandough-juxta-Penarth
records.description: A separate farm in the same parish: 166 acres, NLW D 219/9–13 (1824–1832); the Rees family farm 1841–1910; the 1940 Thomas tenancy. Not a name of the property.

records.title: Great House Farm, Llandough near Cowbridge
records.description: A different Great House Farm in the other Llandough (near Cowbridge, Vale of Glamorgan): sales of 1938 and 1942, the Thomas family 1871–1910.

scope.reason: Another parish, another farm with a similar name.
